note: Open findings and gaps. A finding is closed only by retest evidence or a documented decision, never by editing this file alone.

findings.condition: Central historical backfill was not verified. LastSuccessfulResend remained null and the expected post-resend central query evidence (14-influx-post-resend.txt) was never captured during the v1.0 run.
findings.consequence: An incident cannot be fully reconstructed from central history alone; local RRD4J remains the only continuous record. Permanent data loss is not established - this is an evidence gap, not a proven loss.
root_cause_candidates: CONFIRMED: ResendHistoricDataWorker schedules resend 5-65 minutes after reconnection (DELAY_TRIGGER_TIME + random up to MAX_RANDOM_DELAY); the v1.0 observation window was 48.8 minutes and could end before the drawn delay elapsed. See docs/13-sc06-root-cause.md.
findings.planned_action: EXP-02: rerun with distinctive outage markers, observe at least 66 minutes after reconnection, wait for LastSuccessfulResend to become non-null, capture evidence/backend-loss/14-influx-post-resend.txt, then compare local vs central per predefined window.
findings.closure_criteria: Retest measures missing/duplicate/out-of-order samples within stated tolerance, or the root cause is documented and the INCONCLUSIVE result is kept and scoped.

findings.condition: Decision and review roles exist only as a documented role model. The project has a single author, so no independent review or management oversight has occurred.
findings.consequence: Governance-related obligations can be supported at design level only. Review independence is recorded as SELF_REVIEW throughout.
findings.planned_action: Keep SELF_REVIEW labels accurate. Reassess if a second reviewer becomes available.
findings.closure_criteria: A real second reviewer records an independent review, or the constraint remains documented.

findings.condition: No tabletop incident-notification assessment has been performed against the reporting expectations recorded in the obligations register.
findings.consequence: Reporting-related obligations have no supporting laboratory artefact.
findings.planned_action: TTX-01: tabletop walkthrough of the backend-loss event against notification triggers, with a decision log. No real notification is made.
findings.closure_criteria: A tabletop record exists with trigger analysis, scope decision and identified unknowns.
findings.closure_note: TTX-01 performed as a desk exercise (docs/15-ttx-notification.md). Closure covers the tabletop record only, not real response capability.
